settings.title: 🔄 100% Quality Satisfaction & Return Guarantee
settings.content: Your satisfaction is our top priority. If your organic staples arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect, notify us within 48 hours of delivery for an instant replacement or 100% full refund.

settings.title: 1. Return & Refund Eligibility
settings.content:
Due to the perishable and food-grade nature of our organic farm products (cold-stone ground attas, A2 bilona ghee, unrefined oils), returns are accepted under the following conditions:

  • Transit Damage & Leaks: Product packaging arrived damaged, leaked, or unsealed during transit.
  • Incorrect Item Received: Wrong product variant, weight, or quantity delivered.
  • Quality Concern: Unusable quality issue reported within 48 hours of delivery with photo/video proof.

settings.title: 2. Non-Refundable Exceptions
settings.content:
Refunds or returns cannot be processed under the following circumstances:

  • Opened or consumed food items without verified quality defects.
  • Incorrect shipping address, pincode, or phone number provided at checkout.
  • Delivery failures caused by customer unavailability after 3 courier attempts.

settings.title: 3. Refund Processing & Timelines
settings.content:
Once your return or refund claim is verified by our team:

  • Prepaid Orders (UPI, Cards, NetBanking): Refund credited back to original payment source within 5–7 business days.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD Orders): Refund transferred directly to your bank account or UPI ID within 48 hours of approval.

settings.title: 4. Order Cancellation Policy
settings.content: Orders can be cancelled before they are dispatched from our Surat warehouse (usually within 4 hours of order placement). Once dispatched, orders cannot be cancelled in transit.
